records.name: Chandigarh University
records.description: Chandigarh University in Mohali is one of India's largest and most rapidly growing private universities, with over 30,000 students and consistently ranked among the top private universities nationally. It offers programs in engineering, management, law, architecture, and pharmacy with strong placement infrastructure and MOUs with over 500 global companies. Chandigarh University is known for high placement volumes, particularly in IT, and has strong ties with companies like Infosys, TCS, Wipro, and international tech firms.

records.name: IIT Bombay - Department of Energy Science and Engineering
records.description: IIT Bombay's Department of Energy Science and Engineering is India's premier academic department for energy research and education, offering M.Tech. and Ph.D. programs in renewable energy, energy systems, and sustainable energy technologies. The department conducts research in solar energy, wind power, fuel cells, hydrogen energy, and energy policy, and is associated with national clean energy programs. IIT Bombay's energy graduates are placed in solar energy companies, policy research institutions, and international energy organizations.

records.name: National Institute of Solar Energy (NISE)
records.description: National Institute of Solar Energy (NISE) in Gurugram is the apex national institute under the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy for solar energy research, testing, and capacity building. It offers training programs for solar energy professionals, conducts certification testing of solar panels and systems, and undertakes R&D in PV technology, solar thermal systems, and off-grid solar applications. NISE plays a critical role in India's National Solar Mission and supports the government's 500 GW renewable energy target.

records.name: TERI School of Advanced Studies
records.description: TERI School of Advanced Studies in New Delhi is an academic wing of The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI), offering M.Sc., M.Tech., MBA, and Ph.D. programs in energy, environment, natural resources management, and sustainable development. TERI's research legacy in climate change, clean energy, and sustainable development provides students unique exposure to cutting-edge policy and applied research. Graduates work in renewable energy companies, environmental consultancies, international development organizations, and policy research institutions.

records.name: IIT Roorkee
records.description: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) is India's oldest technical institution, established in 1847 as the Thomason College of Civil Engineering, and the first institution to be granted IIT status in 2001. It offers B.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. programs across 21 departments with strengths in civil engineering, earthquake engineering, water resources, and earth sciences. IIT Roorkee's alumni include leading engineers, scientists, and policymakers, and the institute is home to several national centers of excellence in geotechnical engineering, earthquake technology, and water resources.

records.name: Garuda Aerospace RPTO
records.description: Garuda Aerospace RPTO in Chennai is one of India's largest drone manufacturers and an approved Remote Pilot Training Organisation (RPTO) under DGCA, offering commercial drone pilot training for agricultural, surveillance, and inspection applications. As a DGCA-certified RPTO, it provides theory classes, simulator training, and practical flying hours required for Remote Pilot Certificate (RPC). Garuda Aerospace's training is particularly sought after given the company's close ties with India's booming agri-drone sector.

records.name: IIT Guwahati RPTO (EduRade)
records.description: IIT Guwahati's RPTO (operated through EduRade) is a DGCA-approved Remote Pilot Training Organisation offering drone pilot training for the medium category of drones, providing candidates with systematic theoretical instruction and practical flight training. Backed by IIT Guwahati's academic credibility, the program is well regarded for its quality of training and the comprehensive use of simulation tools. Graduates earn a DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate (RPC) enabling them to operate commercial drones for aerial surveys, agriculture, and inspection tasks.

records.name: Pavaman Aviation RPTO
records.description: Pavaman Aviation RPTO in Hyderabad is a DGCA-approved Remote Pilot Training Organisation offering commercial drone pilot certification programs for both small and medium category drones. The RPTO provides comprehensive ground school instruction and hands-on flight training in drone operations for agriculture, surveillance, photogrammetry, and inspection applications. Pavaman Aviation leverages Hyderabad's status as a growing drone hub to provide students with practical exposure to real-world drone deployment scenarios.

records.name: Berry Avionics RPTO
records.description: Berry Avionics RPTO in Pune is a DGCA-approved Remote Pilot Training Organisation offering drone pilot training programs leading to the Remote Pilot Certificate. The institute offers training for small and medium drone categories with a strong emphasis on technical understanding of UAS systems and safe operations. Berry Avionics' Pune location benefits candidates from Maharashtra's growing drone adoption in agriculture, construction, and logistics.

records.name: DroneAcharya RPTO at IIT Ropar
records.description: DroneAcharya Aerial Innovations operates an RPTO at IIT Ropar, one of India's premier DGCA-approved drone training programs leveraging the academic infrastructure of IIT Ropar. The company is publicly listed on NSE Emerge and offers comprehensive drone pilot training, drone technology courses, and enterprise drone solutions. The IIT Ropar affiliation provides additional credibility and technical rigor to DroneAcharya's training programs for aspiring commercial drone pilots.
